system.description:
The wielder can subjugate up to 6 Hit Dice of humans at once, with normal men counting as 1/2 Hit Die each, operating much like a charm person spell with a range of 60 feet.

Affects humans, demi-humans, and humanoid creatures up to ogre size (excluding animals, magical constructs, and undead). The target receives a saving throw vs. spells; if failed, they become charmed, regarding the user as a trusted friend and defending them from threats.

If a shared language exists, the user may issue suggestions. The victim usually obeys reasonable requests, but automatically refuses suicidal commands or orders directly contrary to their nature/alignment. Conflicting input from former allies causes confusion rather than immediate realization.

The effect ends immediately if the user attacks the victim with a weapon or spell. Otherwise, the victim makes periodic saving throws to break the effect based on Intelligence:

Target Intelligence:

Save Frequency:

High (13-18)

1 day

Average (9-12)

1 week

Low (3-8)

1 month
